f1.text: #6810 (S1 callee 'get buff image-lost frames.vi', docs/wiki/subvi/D1_s1_copy.json:89810) and #22692 (S1 callee 'IMAQdx Get Image.vi') are SubVI nodes in P6 by uid with the same terminal names as S1; the P6 graph stores no SubVI names, so the P6 callee is NOT-DETERMINED by name. #6810 sits directly on d639 of While #637 (loop 1.1, no Case): one call per 1.1 iteration in P6 and in S1. S1: tracker #5058 is on the same d639 and its 'Image In' is #6810's 'Image Out' wire -> 1 call per tracked frame. P6: #5058 is on d23166 of While #10170 (loop 1.2), 'Image In' from #29843 IndexArray (ring slot read): #6810 runs every 1.1 iteration whether or not 1.2 reads that frame, so calls per tracked frame = 1.1 iterations / 1.2 tracked reads (>= 1), a run-time number the graph cannot give. #22692 is under For #22433 / Sequence #21590 / For #21305 in the calibration flat-sequence frames (session path to d26117 'CamSessionOut'), no While: 0 calls per tracked frame in P6 and S1 (identical terminals and partners); calls per calibration = the two For counts, unread.

f2.text: New frame in P6 = Case #22694 frame 'False' (d27219), selector #26879 'x = y?' with x = #6810 'current image number' and y = the previous iteration's value (LSR #27056 <- RSR #27039 on the same wire); d27219 holds the P3a counter #27311 'x+1' (ring write). replay_get_buff_image.vi (842ecad9) = get-buff copy with #529 swapped to the buf stand-in, wire edges unchanged; in it 'Buffer Number In' = the 'Buffer to extract' input and 'Buffer Number Out' = the 'current image number' output, and the stand-in wires BN Out = BN In. In P6 1.1, 'Buffer to extract' = LSR #5351 <- RSR #1117 <- #1978 'x+1', #1978 'x' = #1034 (one frame carries #6810 'current image number', the other 'Buffer to extract'). Under the stand-in both frames give current(i+1) = current(i) + 1, so x != y on every 1.1 iteration and EVERY stand-in frame is classed new and counted (first iteration: constant #27095 vs the start value, both unread). Whether 1.2 then tracks every ring frame is a run-time count (F3), not shown by the graph.

f3.text: Ring discards: #29724 'next discards' -> RSR #29648 only; its outer face (loop exit) is unwired; LSR #29655 (start constant #29662) -> #29724 'discards' only; no indicator, local, or file carries it (no other terminal named 'discard'). A leg cannot read it: NOT READABLE. Per RingSeqCheck's accepted arithmetic the count rises only on an invalid read (valid = n1==n2 AND n1>last), so a frame overwritten before 1.2 reads it (n1 > last+1, still valid) is not counted. S1 lost frames: indicator 'Total Lost Frames' on d3292 (Case #3191 in loop 1.1, fed by #3162 'x-y'), present in P6 too; the v5 leg reads it by label once at the end of RUN_S, before the stop, into the L11 detail -> drive_m8 'total_lost_frames' -> leg.json 'lost' (110-7: '0' both legs): READABLE. No saved file carrying it was found (save trace.vi #376 has no lost-frames input).
